title: classroom50/group/v1
description: Compact record stored in the DESCRIPTION of a per-assignment group team (`classroom50-group-<hash>-<n>`, backing a mode: team assignment — `secret` when teacher-formed, `closed` when student-formed so classmates can browse groups and use GitHub's native request-to-join). The hash in the team name is one-way, so this record is what makes a group team attributable — and safely deletable — after the assignment entry (or the whole config repo) is gone: cleanup enumerates the namespace, requires a full-shape slug match AND a parsed record whose classroom matches, then id-guards the delete, mirroring the invite-team sweep. Written by whichever client founds the team (the teacher tooling or a student-formed accept flow) and re-derived on every write — `additionalProperties` is true only to TOLERATE a field a newer binary adds, never to preserve one. Trust boundary: a student-formed team's maintainer can edit their own team's description, so readers verify the record's classroom+assignment hash back to the team name before trusting it, exactly like the invite-record email check. Keep the encoded JSON small (well under ~250 chars).

classroom.description: Classroom short-name. With `assignment`, must hash back to the team name's hex segment (verified by readers).

assignment.description: Assignment slug. With `classroom`, must hash back to the team name's hex segment (verified by readers).

name.description: Human-readable display name the founding students chose (e.g., "The Sharks"). Display metadata only. Omitted when empty.
